project_type: MQL5 MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisor (GaganEA.mq5) plus a Python (stdlib-only) analysis/automation toolchain and Windows PowerShell/BAT harness that runs the compile->backtest->analyze->commit loop on the user's Windows PC.
language: MQL5 (the EA), Python 3 stdlib-only (tooling + new tuner), Windows PowerShell 5.1+/BAT (orchestration).
build_system: No build system in the Linux sandbox. The EA compiles on the USER'S Windows PC via metaeditor64.exe; backtests run via terminal64.exe (MT5 build 6191, Fusion Markets). None of that is runnable here. Python has NO pip (restricted network) - stdlib only.
test_framework: python3 -m unittest. Existing suite: tools/test_analyze_report.py (16 tests). New tuner tests must be stdlib unittest too.
build_command: In-sandbox: python3 -m py_compile <files>. On the PC: metaeditor64.exe compile (cannot run here).
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py' (existing) and python3 -m unittest for the new tuner tests. Run from repo root or point unittest at the tuner test module.
verification_instructions: 1) python3 -m py_compile on every new/changed .py file. 2) python3 -m unittest the new tuner tests. 3) Re-run tools/test_analyze_report.py and confirm all 16 still pass. 4) grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' across all touched files -> must be EMPTY (pure ASCII; a prior bug: non-ASCII broke the PowerShell parser). 5) If PowerShell touched: check brace/paren/bracket balance and ASCII. 6) After a sample rewrite of GaganEA.mq5 inputs, read through to confirm it still looks like valid compilable MQL5 (cannot compile here - be conservative with the regex).
snapshot_or_generated_files: tools/analyze_report.py writes <basename>.summary.json next to each report. The tuner writes automation/tuner/tuner_state.json (tracked) and per-iteration logs. Reports currently overwrite reports/round01_20260913.html (fixed name) - the tuner must name reports per-iteration/timestamp so history is preserved. No auto-regenerated committed snapshots that must match byte-for-byte.
setup_instructions: Repo already cloned at /projects/sandbox/happyBOT on branch main (synced via git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main). Python3 present. Do NOT commit or push - orchestrator commits to main directly (no-PR workflow).
environment_constraints: Restricted network / COMMON-or-less; treat as no external network for pip - stdlib only. NO MQL5 compiler, NO MT5, NO PowerShell, NO Windows in sandbox. Cannot compile GaganEA.mq5, cannot run MT5 Strategy Tester, cannot execute .ps1/.bat, cannot run the continuous loop. All live MT5/PowerShell/loop behavior is UNVERIFIABLE in-sandbox and must be flagged as such.
contribution_requirements: Pure ASCII across ALL touched files (grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' empty). Never use em dashes. No secrets in scripts. Reuse tools/analyze_report.py for report parsing (import its functions OR read its .summary.json) - do NOT reimplement MT5 report parsing. Preserve existing PowerShell safeguards (compile-log parsing, report detection, Invoke-Git, ShutdownTerminal, no secrets). Do NOT break the existing 16-test analyzer suite. Append a Round 3 entry to ITERATION_LOG.md (no invented performance numbers).
key_patterns: GaganEA.mq5 tunable inputs are DEFAULT compiled-in values on lines matching `input <TYPE> <Name> = <value>;` (name and value separated by variable whitespace; some lines have trailing `// comment`). The ini does NOT set EA inputs - to change strategy params between runs the tuner MUST edit these input default literals in GaganEA.mq5, then it gets recompiled next loop. Note: on gold, *_Pips inputs are POINTS. analyze_report.py exposes analyze_file(path,...) returning a summary dict, and summarize()/summary['metrics'] keys include total_net_profit, profit_factor, relative_drawdown_pct, maximal_drawdown_pct, total_trades, win_rate_pct, recovery_factor, sharpe_ratio (see reports/samples/*.summary.json for the full schema). The .summary.json is written next to each report. PowerShell loop (automation/run_backtest_loop.ps1) has functions Write-Log, Fail, Invoke-AndWait, Invoke-Git, Write-NewestTesterLogTail; $Config block holds machine paths; steps (a)pull (b)copy (c)compile (d)tester (e)locate+copy report (f)analyze (g)git add/commit/push; report base name comes from RoundTag+RunDate; __REPORT_NAME__/__EXPERT_PATH__ tokens substituted into backtest_template.ini at runtime.
relevant_files: GaganEA.mq5 (input default lines ~42-133; header/version ~1-16; the rewriter edits these)
tools/analyze_report.py (reuse analyze_file / summarize; summary JSON schema)
tools/test_analyze_report.py (existing 16-test suite pattern to mirror; must keep passing)
automation/run_backtest_loop.ps1 (existing harness to extend/duplicate; Invoke-Git, $Config, step layout)
automation/backtest_template.ini ([Tester] config; Report= bare name; Symbol XAUUSD, Period M1, Model 4)
ITERATION_LOG.md (Round 3 entry to append; Round 2 result documents the negative-edge framing)
directory_structure: Repo root: GaganEA.mq5, README.md, ITERATION_LOG.md, .gitignore. tools/ (analyze_report.py + test). automation/ (run_backtest_loop.ps1/.bat, backtest_template.ini, SETUP.md, logs/ ignored). reports/ (round HTML + summary.json, samples/). New work goes under automation/tuner/.
